#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string line;
    std::getline(std::cin, line);

    // Replace only the first 'at' with '@'
    size_t pos = line.find("at");
    if (pos != std::string::npos) {
        line.replace(pos, 2, "@");
    }

    // Replace all 'dot' with '.'
    size_t start_pos = 0;
    while ((start_pos = line.find("dot", start_pos)) != std::string::npos) {
        line.replace(start_pos, 3, ".");
        start_pos += 1; // move forward to avoid infinite loop
    }

    // If string starts with '.', prepend 'dot'
    if (!line.empty() && line[0] == '.') {
        line = "dot" + line.substr(1);
    }

    // If string starts with '@', replace first 'at' with '@' and prepend 'at'
    if (!line.empty() && line[0] == '@') {
        size_t at_pos = line.find("at");
        if (at_pos != std::string::npos) {
            line.replace(at_pos, 2, "@");
        }
        line = "at" + line.substr(1);
    }

    // If string ends with '.', replace with 'dot'
    if (!line.empty() && line.back() == '.') {
        line.back() = 'd';
        line += "ot";
    }

    std::cout << line << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
